title: Janken (rock-paper-scissors) Robot with 100% winning rate
summary: A University of Tokyo demo of a rock-paper-scissors robot that always wins, using high-speed vision to read the human hand and respond faster than people can perceive.
why: Cited as a vivid example of machines outpacing human reaction times and of high-speed robotic vision.

quote.text: It is so fast that unless you are watching it on high-speed film, you can't tell that it is cheating.
